game.title: Kansas City Chiefs at Las Vegas Raiders

lede: Kansas City Chiefs carries the stronger EdgeDesk offensive profile (#16 in EPA per play) and the better defensive rating with it, so the ratings point the same way on both sides of the ball.
EdgeDesk’s independent projection makes it Las Vegas Raiders +5.1 with a fair total of 40.6 — inside a touchdown, before any sportsbook number is consulted.

The widest measured matchup on the board is Las Vegas Raiders run offence vs Kansas City Chiefs run defence, which sits −0.236 from the league mean once the two ratings are combined the way the model combines them.
The largest uncertainty is quarterback information: Kansas City Chiefs and Las Vegas Raiders have no confirmed starter on file, which materially affects how much confidence the exact number deserves.
